up: List all distinct molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3833083. For each molecule, provide its molecule ChEMBL identifier and its canonical SMILES. Only include molecules that have a chemical structure available (i.e., canonical SMILES is not null). Return each distinct molecule once.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN compound_records cr ON md.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs ON cr.doc_id = docs.doc_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3833083' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL;
